assertions.assertion: The CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 is being appealed.
The service billed under CPT 93271 is a cardiac event monitoring study.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The clinical indication raises concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis code I48.0 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation) is supported.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis code Z86.73 (personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction) is supported.
The diagnosis code G45.9 (transient cerebral ischemic events) is supported.
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
The service billed under CPT 93271 is medically necessary.
The request is for reversal of the CO-97 denial.
The outstanding balance to be paid is 349.19.
